name: Dire Maul: Zevrim Thornhoof's Ascension Sacrifice carries its target to the altar
contract: Zevrim Thornhoof 11490 casts the Ascension Sacrifice 2100215 at a random player in a dungeon group. Its effect 0
teleports the target to a database destination (TARGET_DEST_DB, spell_target_position), effect 1 stuns it and
effect 2 links the periodic drain 2100216. The stock Sacrifice 22651 has its altar row at map 429 (-25.98, -448.24,
-36.09); the Ascension spell needs the same destination row, or the teleport lands on the target itself. The
player enters the dungeon at the East Wing east entrance, 390 yd from the altar, the boss is summoned beside the
player and casts Sacrifice on it. The player must end up at the altar on map 429, stunned, with the drain linked.
A control checks the player starts far from the altar. The players are level 57 humans, matching the boss, and a
health fixture keeps the player alive.

steps.label: Let the character finish logging in
CONTROL: victim is inside the dungeon
CONTROL: victim starts far from the altar
Summon the boss in the victim's instance
Let the boss's spawn events settle
Zevrim casts the Ascension Sacrifice on the victim
Sacrifice carries the victim to the altar
the victim is still in the dungeon
